name: determinants_shap
description: Per-feature LightGBM SHAP values (pred_contrib, mean over the out-of-fold boosters) of the model rows for the top 20 encoded model columns by mean |SHAP|, for V15(c) (GIPPA_SPEC.md §10.2, §7.8.2; docs/specs/M9-17-plot-support-analysis.md). Summed by block over every column they equal determinants_attribution.tsv's shap_<block> columns. Written by the determinants step. Not a result table.

fields.name: feature_value
fields.description: Model-matrix value of the column for this gene (tir_ostir and length_aa on their ln scale); NA when missing

fields.name: shap
fields.description: Mean over the out-of-fold boosters of the column's pred_contrib
